composition_variation: Create a warm pastel storybook portrait of Himawari Nohara from Crayon Shin-chan sitting safely on a thick nursery floor mat. She wears a fully covering pale yellow baby romper with socks, and her distinctive curled auburn hair and lively eyes are clearly visible. A small plush bear rests securely in her lap, held with both simple mitten-like hands. Use creamy peach sunlight, lavender toy blocks near the floor, pale wood, and a broad softly shaded upper nursery wall. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
